role: Independent-task confirmation subset after exploratory inspection of the first 30 frozen-order seed-43 tasks
task_selection: Positions 31 through 102, inclusive, in the parent protocol's immutable task_ids order
status_at_freeze: No success outcomes or trajectories of these 72 tasks were inspected; some API requests may already have been in progress or checkpointed
primary: Paired whole-task success difference, ICR advice minus native, across all 72 selected tasks
analysis: Two-sided exact McNemar test and 100000 paired task-bootstrap draws, without interim outcome inspection
robustness: Also report 100000-draw cluster-bootstrap intervals after grouping tasks by identical released reference path and separately by target datatype; these use public task metadata only and are descriptive sensitivity checks
mechanism_diagnostic: For each discordant pair, record whether an ICR recovery event occurred; this post-treatment association is descriptive, not a causal subgroup estimand
decision_rule: The main paper may state a confirmed task-level improvement only if the independent 72-task difference is positive, the exact two-sided McNemar p-value is below 0.05, and the paired bootstrap 95% interval excludes zero; otherwise lead with the validated structural and effect-certificate claims
third_arm: Global-certified advice is deferred as a separately costed attribution question
